articles.summary: Net loss of $419.7 million ($2.65 per diluted common share) for the third quarter of 2026; after-tax adjusted operating income of $349.0 million ($2.20 per diluted common share). Core operations top-line trends remained strong with premium growth of 4.7 percent on a constant currency basis. Core operations margins were also strong, including an adjusted operating return on equity of 21.3 percent, and traditional U.S. life insurance company statutory operating earnings were solid at approximately $300 million when adjusting for the impacts related to the anticipated closing of our external reinsurance transaction. The annual GAAP reserve assumption updates increased net income by $23.5 million, reflecting a decrease in reserves driven primarily by favorable trends in Unum US and Colonial Life. Capital return continued at a consistent pace, with approximately $200 million of shares repurchased and $80.1 million of common stock dividends, bringing year-to-date capital return to $1,038.5

articles.summary: Unum Group (NYSE: UNM) announced today that its Unum Life Insurance Company of America subsidiary (Unum America) closed its previously announced reinsurance transaction with Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re). As a part of the transaction, Fortitude Re will retrocede biometric risk to a highly rated global reinsurer. Unum will continue to provide service and administration for the reinsured business. The reinsured block consists of approximately 50,000 individual LTC policies with $3.8 billion of statutory reserves and approximately $4.5 billion of best estimate reserves. Following the transaction, Unum’s remaining LTC block is predominantly group LTC policies, which generally have more basic benefit structures than individual LTC policies, with the remaining block supported by robust reserve margins. The transaction represents significant progress in Unum’s execution of its closed block strategy and follows the company’s previous LTC reinsurance transaction in 2025.
articles.title: Unum Group Closes $3.8 Billion Long-Term Care Reinsurance Transaction with Fortitude Re
